Platte County Assessor's Office
Assessor Marcus Farr
Our Mission:
Committed to providing fair, accurate, and transparent property assessments. We serve the citizens of Platte County with respect, integrity, and accountability while supporting the needs of our community.
Mon - Fri 8am to 4:30pm
Personal Property Division: (816) 858-3310 personal.property@co.platte.mo.us business.personal@co.platte.mo.us
Mapping & GIS Division: (816) 858-1240 gis@co.platte.mo.us
Real Estate Staff: (816) 858-3316 joverton@co.platte.mo.us residential.re@co.platte.mo.us commercial.appraiser@co.platte.mo.us
Sales Validation & Education Coordinator ( 816) 858-1256 assessor.edu@co.platte.mo.us
Important Dates & Deadlines
October 12th - Closed for Columbus Day
November1st - Tax bills go out in the mail via Collector's Office
November 11th - Closed for Veteran's day
November 26th & 27th - Closed for Thanksgiving Holiday
December 24th & 25th - Closed for Christmas Holiday
December 31st - Last day to pay county taxes without penalties.

Assessor's Office Data Collector Vehicles
The Assessor's office staff are in the field verifying Sales, Permit Data and Reinspecting parcels as required per state guidelines. The Data Collectors are easily identifiable by our county vehicles with decals located on the front doors on either side and will have county logoed shirts & employee badges.
